content:
Use REFERENCE IMAGE LOCK to keep the same character identity across the entire Seedance video by explicitly listing immutable traits (face, eye shape, hair, skin tone, body proportions, clothing/accessories) and repeating them in the prompt.

Enable STRICT STORYBOARD MODE and instruct Seedance to follow panels/scenes in exact order with “DO NOT SKIP, REORDER, MERGE, OR MODIFY ANY PANEL” to enforce sequence adherence.

Specify exact output constraints in the prompt (Vertical 9:16, 10 seconds, fast-paced cinematic edit, one continuous journey) to control format and pacing.

Lock wardrobe and location continuity by defining a mandatory jersey sequence and mandatory location sequence per scene to prevent model drift.

Create seamless scene transitions by enforcing an object-driven transition rule (same football connects every scene; football must completely fill the frame before every scene change; no fades/dissolves/jump cuts).

Add camera direction per scene (e.g., medium close-up, handheld stabilized, side tracking, low-angle, slow push-in) to control shot composition and motion consistency.

Use a negative prompt that explicitly bans identity changes, duplicates, extra limbs/fingers, unrealistic physics, and forbidden transition types (fade/dissolve/jump cuts) to reduce common Seedance artifacts.

Generate a separate multi-panel storyboard image (3×3 grid, numbered panels with bullet actions) using GPT Image 2, then use it to guide the Seedance video for tighter narrative continuity.

使用 REFERENCE IMAGE LOCK，通过明确列出不可变特征（面部、眼形、发型、肤色、身体比例、服装/配饰）并在 prompt 中重复它们，以保持整个 Seedance 视频中相同的角色身份。

启用 STRICT STORYBOARD MODE，并指示 Seedance 按顺序严格遵循面板/场景，使用“DO NOT SKIP, REORDER, MERGE, OR MODIFY ANY PANEL”来强制顺序遵循。

在 prompt 中指定精确的输出限制（垂直 9:16，10 秒，快速节奏的电影剪辑，一个连续的旅程）以控制格式和节奏。

通过为每个场景定义强制性的球衣顺序和强制性的位置顺序来锁定服装和位置的连续性，以防止模型漂移。

通过执行基于物体的过渡规则（同一个足球连接每个场景；足球必须在每次场景更换前完全填满画面；无淡入/淡出/跳切）来创建无缝的场景过渡。

为每个场景添加摄像机方向（例如，中景特写、手持稳定、侧面跟踪、低角度、慢推入）以控制镜头构图和运动一致性。

使用负面 prompt 明确禁止身份变化、重复、额外的肢体/手指、不现实的物理现象和禁止的过渡类型（淡入/淡出/跳切）以减少常见的 Seedance 伪影。

使用 GPT Image 2 生成一个单独的多面板故事板图像（3×3 网格，编号面板带有项目符号动作），然后使用它来指导 Seedance 视频以实现更紧密的叙事连续性。
